title: PathXAI: Evidence-guided structured pathology reporting by transferable tissue segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.09117v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pathology reporting requires translating tissue observations across regions and slides into specific diagnoses and supporting morphological descriptions. However, the use of explicit tissue-composition measurements to guide H&E-based report generation remains underexplored. Thus, we developed PathXAI, which combines segmentation-derived tissue information with H&E images and optional domain knowledge to guide diagnostic reasoning, targeted reinspection and structured report writing. Its segmentation component exceeded baselines in mean Dice on internal and external tests. In automated report evaluation on 1,200 public and 151 private cases, PathXAI achieved higher agreement with reference diagnoses and documented morphology than the H&E-based comparators. On the public evaluation cohort, PathXAI-Report exceeded Qwen + H&E in cancer family match rate by 4.4 percentage points and in finding F1 by 5.7 percentage points. PathXAI generates

translated_title: PathXAI：基于可迁移组织分割的证据引导结构化病理报告生成
translated_abstract: 病理报告需要将跨区域和跨切片的组织观察转化为具体诊断及支持性的形态学描述。然而，利用明确的组织构成测量来指导基于H&E（苏木精-伊红染色）图像的报告生成仍鲜有探索。因此，我们开发了PathXAI，该方法将分割得到的组织信息与H&E图像及可选的领域知识相结合，以指导诊断推理、针对性复查和结构化报告撰写。其分割组件在内部和外部测试集上的平均Dice系数均超过基线方法。在1,200例公开病例和151例私有病例的自动化报告评估中，PathXAI与参考诊断及已记录形态学的一致性高于基于H&E的对比方法。在公开评估队列上，PathXAI-Report在癌家族匹配率上超过Qwen + H&E 4.4个百分点，在发现项F1分数上超过5.7个百分点。
tldr: PathXAI通过可迁移的组织分割信息结合H&E图像与领域知识来引导诊断推理和结构化病理报告生成，在诊断一致性和形态学描述准确性上显著优于纯H&E方法。
en_tdlr: PathXAI leverages transferable tissue segmentation combined with H&E images and optional domain knowledge to guide diagnostic reasoning and structured pathology report generation, achieving higher diagnostic agreement and morphological accuracy than H&E-only baselines.
